surgeRaids.protect.label: Protect raids
surgeRaids.protect.hint: A raid into your channel turns on watchers-only chat for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
surgeRaids.protect.note: Raiders who were really watching the channel that raided you can chat right away. New accounts and bots wait.
surgeRaids.banner.from: Raid from {channel}: {count, plural, =0 {no verified viewers} one {# verified viewer} other {# verified viewers}}.
surgeRaids.panel.note: The channel you raid may have raid protection on. Then only your viewers who were really watching can chat there at first.
